programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.sub-title: The Tale Of The Angry Cat
programme.desc: When Peter accidentally brings home Mr McGregor's cat rather than a cart of freshly picked brussels sprouts, he has to find a way to lure the angry cat back into the garden while staying one step ahead of her claws!

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: PJ Robot is scared of the mystical villain, Pharaoh Boy, but when the PJ Masks need him, he faces his fear.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston needs rescuing from a cable car. Will he stay stuck for long?

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: When Baby Mouse won't take a nap, Vida runs a sleep study to figure out what's keeping her up!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels had a great adventure outside and want to tell everyone about it. What better way to tell a story than through a Puppet Show! First they make the puppets. Scissors! Card! Glue! Glitter! Feathers!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa finds out what babies are really like and what they can do.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a pod of hungry Pea-Rexes, Ginger discovers some unexpected guests hiding in her tail - three baby Pea Rexes, Minty, Wasabi and Split.

programme.title: It's Andrew!
programme.desc: Spark teaches Andrew, Dazzle and Gregasus how to be really SERIOUS, so that they can convince Ms Horn they should have more play time.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: Pounce leads an adventure into a cave, but the cadets become trapped by the rising tide. Meanwhile, Frizzy goes in search of a volcano.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.sub-title: The Octonauts And The Midnight Zone
programme.desc: While exploring the deepest part of the ocean, the Midnight Zone, the Octonauts discover a strange rock that happens to be home to a new species of worm.

programme.title: Thomas and Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Nia has volunteered for a big day of deliveries and is determined to make the perfect plan to get it done, but when things start to go awry, she doggedly sticks to her plan and refuses any help.

programme.title: Play School: What's Cooking?
programme.desc: Alex and Rachael are looking for a delicious drink and scrumptious snack to eat! Luckily, food lover Melissa Leong is here to help them make super green smoothies and pink dragon fruit muffins.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.sub-title: The Way Of The Wild Walkers
programme.desc: When Peter creates a wild and adventurous trail for Scoop Dooley to follow, they both end up getting lost.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Today is Poppy's birthday! Miffy and Grunty then prepare a great gift: draw a pretty butterfly! The problem is that they don't know how to draw them.

programme.title: The Woohoos!
programme.desc: The Woohoos find new plants which Ellie didn't plant have grown in the veg patch. The Woohoos work out that birds are nature's gardener and sometimes they are, without even knowing it!

How will those two mothers end their fierce revenge?
